scientific_limitations: At the disturbed 500 km blackout peak, 0/20 nominal 95% position ellipsoids covered truth for every stochastic model.
800 km tracking did not recover the simulated density disturbance.
One realistic-force stress case produced large errors; its density fit did not converge.
A sampled-posterior validation is unavailable for any check that timed out or failed diagnostics.
All primary accuracy results use controlled synthetic truth, not flight observations.
